title: Hook events: agents, tasks, notifications and stop
description: Event arrays (`hookEvent_<Event>`) and matcher groups (`hookMatcherGroup_<Event>`) for: Notification, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, Stop, StopFailure, TeammateIdle.

hookEvent_Notification.title: Notification
hookEvent_Notification.description: When Claude Code sends a notification.

hookMatcherGroup_Notification.description: Matcher group for Notification: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on the notification type. Values: `permission_prompt`, `idle_prompt`, `auth_success`, `elicitation_dialog`, `elicitation_url_dialog`, `elicitation_complete`, `elicitation_response`, `agent_needs_input`, `agent_completed`, `quota_auto_resume_fired`, `quota_auto_resume_stale`, `quota_auto_resume_disabled`, `plugin_notification` (a mod raises a notification with `$.ui.notify`). Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_`, `-`, spaces, `,` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`/`,`-separated list of exact strings; any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression (RegExp.test). `agent_needs_input`/`agent_completed` need v2.1.198+; the three `quota_auto_resume_*` types need v2.1.234+.
matcher.title: Matcher

hooks.description: Hook handlers to run when the matcher applies; all matching handlers run in parallel and identical handlers from several settings files run once.

hookEvent_StopFailure.title: StopFailure
hookEvent_StopFailure.description: When the turn ends because of an API error. Output and exit code are ignored except `terminalSequence`.

hookMatcherGroup_StopFailure.description: Matcher group for StopFailure: an optional matcher plus the handlers to run when it applies. Handlers allowed here: command, http or mcp_tool (prompt and agent hooks are not supported on this event). The `if` field is not evaluated on this event, so a handler that sets it never runs.

matcher.description: Filters on the error type. Values: `rate_limit`, `overloaded`, `authentication_failed`, `oauth_org_not_allowed`, `account_on_hold`, `billing_error`, `invalid_request`, `model_not_found`, `server_error`, `max_output_tokens`, `cloud_credential_error`, `unknown`. Evaluation: `*`, an empty string, or an omitted matcher matches everything; a value made only of letters, digits, `_` and `|` is an exact string or a `|`-separated list of exact strings (a hyphen, space or comma switches it to the regular-expression path and only `|` separates alternatives); any other character makes it an unanchored JavaScript regular expression. Matching `cloud_credential_error` needs v2.1.267+.
